capabilities: start a writing session from a status-bar button
show words written when the timer hits zero
extras: The README warns that the plugin only tracks the file open when the timer starts, so words typed in other files during the session are not counted.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in timer for structured writing sessions with word-count feedback.
summary: Status-bar writing timer that starts timed writing sessions and reports how many words you wrote when the timer ends.
